turns.user_utterance: It was the exchange rate – I withdrew cash in euros in Paris and got far less euros than the rate I expected.
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—this sounds like the exchange rate applied for a cash withdrawal was different from what you expected. Can you confirm whether you selected “Dynamic Currency Conversion” (DCC) / the option to pay in euros on the ATM screen?
